testCase:

Goal: Add a $50 gift card to the cart.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-17/
STEP 2: Hover over "Gift cards"
STEP 3: Click "Buy a gift card"
STEP 4: Click "$50"

steps.note: Reveal the gift card purchase option.
Open the gift card purchase flow.
Add the selected gift card to the cart.

args.text: Gift card added to the cart

steps.note: Verify the requested cart confirmation is visible.

reasoning: This test verifies that a $50 gift card can be added to the cart. The plan follows the specified hover-and-click flow and checks the exact confirmation text.
